in_marathi.name: Dharaani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who carries, supports
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharaani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Dharaani represents the divine power that supports and nourishes all creation. The name signifies strength, resilience, and the ability to carry the weight of the universe.
